title: KiCad board, model, EAGLE file, model
how: Chain: read the KiCad board into the model, write it as an EAGLE file, read that back;
the facts compared are the ones that EAGLE keeps: counts of components (3), placed pads (6), nets (2), pad nets (5), track pieces (1), vias (1) and outline points (4),
positions of pads, vias, track ends and outline points, references with values, net names and pad net names, with an exact tolerance.
